title: Information discarded by urinary albumin normalization: an exploratory negative test for grip-strength prediction
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2011–2012 to 2013–2014 temporal transport (n=3905 and 4386), retaining spot urine creatinine alongside UACR did not establish improved combined-grip prediction beyond flexible standard anthropometric and serum measures: weighted MSE difference -0.086190 kg², joint survey-PSU bootstrap 95% interval [-1.257478, 3.977860].
